title: EV charging in Finland | VOOL
description: VOOL chargers and load management in Finland: local partners, grants and rules, and datasheets.

sections.title: EV charging for buildings in Finland, on the connection they already have
sections.lead: Chargers, load management and billing from one maker. Sold and installed by 10 partners in Finland.

sections.title: Grants and rules in Finland
paragraphs: Finland has supported charging readiness in housing companies for several years through the state charging infrastructure grant (latausinfra-avustus). The terms and the budget are set each year.
points: The grant has been aimed at housing companies and their parking companies that build charging readiness for at least five parking spaces.
It has covered changes to the property’s electrical system, such as switchboards and cabling.
Check the current call and its conditions before the general meeting decides. Your installer can help with the application.

items.title: Apartment buildings
items.text: Many chargers on the existing main fuse, with each resident paying for their own charging.

items.title: Offices and fleets
items.text: Employees pay for private charging; company cars are reported separately.

items.title: Developers
items.text: Design charging into new buildings and size the connection smaller.

items.title: Sell or install VOOL in Finland
items.text: We are adding partners in this market.

items.q: Where can I buy VOOL in Finland?
items.a: From electrical wholesalers and installers; see the partner list on this page.
No. Local partners sell and install. VOOL makes the hardware and software and supports the partners.
From 1 January 2027 newly installed chargers in the EU must support ISO 15118-20. The new VOOL Charger does.

sections.title: Planning charging in Finland?
sections.lead: Send us the parking spaces and the main fuse size. We reply within one working day.
